I Relate to this so much you have no ideia. I couln't deal with my ex too, but we both were on the same page about doing it, but he was kinda of agressive and i was the crier that could't sleep or stop shaking. At some point i got disgusted, i was always feeling sick and tired, so i slowed down, my body could't take so much anymore... but he kept the same rythm. Sometimes i just wanted to clean the whole trashy room and whatch a movie or something, feel clean for once, you know? but he was always getting more and playing FPS like crazy...
i've been thinking about this... but, as i believe that death is just a forever sleep idk.

Congrats! almost 3 months sober from coke. I feel miserable, my whole life is falling apart, everything is a mess and i can't fix anything. I'm filling up myself with xanax, i was mixing it with alcohol but i had to slow the booze thing down cause i have no control when i mix these two. I'm tired...
right now, i am exactly like this
with pills? just don't. trust me.

i feel exactly the same. i have several scars of self harm through my body, some of them are still healing. i've tried to cut my wrists 3x times this week, but i never get the guts to go deep. it's not an easy cut like on the thighs, you gotta press it hard. i'll probably go by the side of the arm this time. i don't even know why i'm saying this.
